ABOUT THIS MAP

This visualization presents resilience-related research across the United States.

Use the filters on the left to explore studies by theme, location, and infrastructure type.

States with a higher concentration of studies appear in darker shades of blue. The data was collected from the National Transportation Library's Repository, Scimago Journal & Country Rank, Open Science Access Portal, and the Transportation Research Information Service (TRIS).

The map also highlights the most relevant disasters. Use the Section filter to explore disaster-related studies. The data includes studies widespread across the United States and also studies from outside the USA.

If you want to check the complete dataset, please download the Excel file by clicking the button below.
